interpretation: These are historical event-level analogs, not observed July-August 2026 counts or future daily targets.
A two-month final test may be underpowered for gas: repeated messages collapse to 62/67 positive channel-days in the observed analogs.
No blind period is reserved. The local source ends on 2026-06-30; adequacy of any future unseen sample depends on target unit, eligibility, episode independence, and predeclared metric precision.
method: Event counts from prepared-quality-audit.json monthly_by_sensor for July/August; distinct positive channel-days/channels/calendar days from curated month Parquet with WHERE alarm AND optional sensor_type=Газовый датчик, grouped by channel_id and CAST(substr(event_ts_local_raw,1,10) AS DATE). Existing alarm-spike-exclusions-v1 has no rule in July/August 2024/2025.
